oneconfig.preferences.keybind.title: OneConfig Keybind
oneconfig.preferences.keybind.descriptio: The keybind used to open the OneConfig menu.
oneconfig.preferences.keybind_closes_gui: Pressing the OneConfig keybind while the menu or HUD editor is open closes it, instead of switching between the two.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_settings_keybi: Opens the settings panel for the currently selected HUD in the HUD editor.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_visibility_key: Toggles the visibility of the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_lock_keybind.d: Locks or unlocks the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_copy_keybind.d: Copies the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor to the clipboard.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_cut_keybind.de: Copies the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor to the clipboard and deletes them.
Pastes the HUDs from the clipboard into the HUD editor at the pointer position.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_duplicate_keyb: Duplicates the currently selected HUD in the HUD editor.
Resets all properties of the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_delete_keybind: Deletes the currently selected HUDs in the HUD editor.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_select_all_key: Selects all unlocked HUDs in the HUD editor.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_undo_keybind.d: Undoes the last change made in the HUD editor.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_redo_keybind.d: Redoes the last change undone in the HUD editor.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_redo_alt_keybi: A second shortcut for redoing the last change undone in the HUD editor.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_show_keybind_h: Shows the keyboard shortcut next to each action in the HUD editor context menu.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_marquee_anim.d: Fades the selection rectangle in and out when drag-selecting HUDs in the editor.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_marquee_anim_d: The duration of the fade animation for the drag selection rectangle in milliseconds.
oneconfig.preferences.background_blur.de: Blurs the full game background when the OneConfig menu is open.
oneconfig.preferences.hud_drag_ui_opacit: How visible the OneConfig menu stays while you drag a HUD. 0 = fully transparent, 1 = no fade.
oneconfig.preferences.page_opacity.title: Page Opacity
oneconfig.preferences.page_opacity.descr: How opaque the OneConfig content panel background is. 0 = fully transparent, 100 = fully opaque.
oneconfig.preferences.sidebar_opacity.de: How opaque the OneConfig sidebar background is. 0 = fully transparent, 100 = fully opaque.
oneconfig.preferences.glow_opacity.title: Background Glow Opacity
oneconfig.preferences.glow_opacity.descr: How strong the accent-coloured glow behind the OneConfig menu is. 0 = hidden, 100 = fully opaque.
oneconfig.preferences.pause_game.title: Pause Game
oneconfig.preferences.pause_game.descrip: Pause singleplayer worlds while the OneConfig menu is open.
oneconfig.preferences.ui_scale.title: UI Scale
oneconfig.preferences.ui_scale.descripti: Size of the OneConfig menu in percent. 100 fits it to the window.
oneconfig.preferences.pixel_grid.title: Pixel Grid
oneconfig.preferences.pixel_grid.descrip: Round the UI scale so pixel fonts stay sharp. Automatic only does this for the Minecraft theme.
oneconfig.preferences.remember_last_page: Reopens the page you were on if you come back within this time. Otherwise opens the Mods page.
oneconfig.preferences.restore_hud_editor: Reopens the HUD editor instead of the OneConfig menu when the HUD editor was the last page you closed.
oneconfig.preferences.show_opening_page_: Plays the page animation when the menu is first opened.
oneconfig.preferences.instant_search.des: Focuses the search bar when the OneConfig menu opens or you change pages.
oneconfig.preferences.search_keybind.des: Focuses the search bar in the OneConfig menu and HUD editor.
oneconfig.preferences.show_option_action: Shows a more actions button on active option rows. Right-click options still opens the same menu.
oneconfig.preferences.flip_top_option_or: Moves the Edit HUD and Global Search buttons to the bottom of the sidebar, above your account.
oneconfig.preferences.search_distance.de: The maximum Levenshtein distance used when fuzzy-matching search queries.

Plays an animation when closing the OneConfig menu.
oneconfig.preferences.opening_time.title: Opening Time
oneconfig.preferences.opening_time.descr: Duration of the opening and closing animations, in seconds.
oneconfig.preferences.ui_sounds.title: UI Sounds
oneconfig.preferences.ui_sounds.descript: Play sound effects when interacting with the OneConfig menu and HUD designer.
oneconfig.preferences.menu_sounds.title: Menu Sounds
oneconfig.preferences.menu_sounds.descri: Play sounds when opening and closing OneConfig screens.
oneconfig.preferences.click_sounds.title: Click Sounds
oneconfig.preferences.click_sounds.descr: Play sounds when clicking OneConfig controls.
oneconfig.preferences.slider_sounds.desc: Play tick sounds when dragging sliders and ordered lists.
Play sounds when selecting, dragging, and resizing HUD elements.
oneconfig.preferences.ui_ambience.title: UI Ambience
oneconfig.preferences.ui_ambience.descri: Play a soft ambient loop while the OneConfig menu or HUD designer is open.
oneconfig.preferences.duck_music.title: Duck Music During Ambience
oneconfig.preferences.duck_music.descrip: Lower Minecraft music while OneConfig ambience is playing.
oneconfig.preferences.ui_sound_volume.de: Volume of OneConfig's UI sound effects.
oneconfig.preferences.page_animation_dur: Duration of page transition animations, in seconds.
oneconfig.preferences.show_first_launch_: Show the welcome message the first time OneConfig is launched.
oneconfig.preferences.profile_switch_toa: Show a notification when a profile keybind switches your profile.
oneconfig.notification.first_launch.mess: Press '%s' to open OneConfig and access all your mod settings in one place.
oneconfig.hud.tour.welcome.title: Welcome to the HUD editor
oneconfig.hud.tour.welcome.body: This is where you place and style your HUDs. Here's a quick tour of the basics.
oneconfig.hud.tour.adding.title: Add HUDs
oneconfig.hud.tour.adding.body: Click a HUD in the library to drop it in the middle of the screen, or drag it to where you want it. Most HUDs can be added more than once, each with its own settings.
oneconfig.hud.tour.dragging.title: Move and resize
oneconfig.hud.tour.dragging.body: Drag a HUD to move it. It snaps to the screen edges and other HUDs. Hold Alt to place it freely. Drag a corner to resize it. Drag across empty space to select several HUDs at once.
oneconfig.hud.tour.merging.title: Merge HUDs
oneconfig.hud.tour.merging.body: Stack HUDs on top of each other, or put them side by side, and their backgrounds merge into one shape. Drag any of them to move the merged HUDs together. To pull one out, click it first, then drag it away.
oneconfig.hud.tour.merging.task: Try it: stack a HUD right above or below another one until their backgrounds merge.
oneconfig.hud.tour.merging.task_add: Try it: add another text HUD from the library, then stack it right above or below the first one.
oneconfig.hud.tour.anchoring.title: Anchor HUDs
oneconfig.hud.tour.anchoring.body: Right-click a HUD to open this menu, then pick Anchor. Click a point on your HUD, then a point on another HUD. It will now follow that HUD wherever it moves.
oneconfig.hud.tour.settings.title: Settings
oneconfig.hud.tour.settings.body: Click a HUD to open this panel. The Settings tab covers position, scale, background, merging and visibility.
oneconfig.hud.tour.designer.title: Designer
oneconfig.hud.tour.designer.body: The Designer tab changes how the HUD looks: its size, alignment, padding and colours.
oneconfig.hud.tour.fonts.title: Fonts and text
oneconfig.hud.tour.fonts.body: In Designer, Text Options lets you switch between the Minecraft and Poppins fonts, and change the size, weight, style and case.
oneconfig.hud.tour.done.title: You're all set
oneconfig.hud.tour.done.body: Right-click empty space and pick Editor Tour to see this again.
